title: Boss Case: The Insider
story: Someone changed the firewall rule at 01:30 and the logs disagree. Combine three witnesses.
goal: Find who changed the firewall: the change time is in fw.log, who was logged in is in sessions.log, and uid mapping is in passwd.txt. Answer with the username.

files./case/fw.log: 01:30 rule changed by uid=1007 via ssh
files./case/sessions.log:
01:25 uid=1004 login
01:28 uid=1007 login
01:40 uid=1007 logout

hints: fw.log gives a uid, not a name.
Look the uid up in passwd.txt, then check that sessions.log agrees.

Run:
cat /case/fw.log
cat /case/sessions.log
cat /case/passwd.txt
Then answer: sandhya
socratic: Which file is the oldest witness?
Do two files tell different stories?
Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
